# 260 Faust architecture comparison: consider a restricted offline authoring path

One-line summary: Faust's offline functional graph lowering aligns with V2's prepared-effect model,
but its JIT, fast-math defaults, generic state, work-stealing and whole-file sound resources do not;
consider only pinned generated native effects adapted to the existing V2 contract.

**This is a completed research and decision record, not implementation authority.**

**Authority: GitHub issue #260.** This local file mirrors its source-backed decision record.

## Authority, pins and method

- Engine V2: [`90c3b9a598f1244938d9cdcce04c4a4641c6b758`](https://github.com/misofm/engine-v2/tree/90c3b9a598f1244938d9cdcce04c4a4641c6b758).
- Faust: [`ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350`](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/tree/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350).
- Source was inspected without builds, benchmarks or legacy Miso access.

## Findings

Faust is an offline functional DSP compiler targeting C/C++, LLVM and Wasm, with optional libfaust
JIT use ([README](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/README.md#L9-L23)).
Its `dsp` abstraction has fixed I/O, initialization, clearing, cloning and planar `compute`, while
factories expose source identity, options and metadata
([dsp.h](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/architecture/faust/dsp/dsp.h#L88-L292)).
This is architecturally close to an offline producer of prepared V2 native effects.

It is not a drop-in V2 backend. LLVM enables fast math unless disabled, JIT settings permit fusion
and unsafe math, and the Clang path passes `-ffast-math`
([LLVM](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/compiler/generator/llvm/llvm_code_container.cpp#L72-L91),
[JIT flags](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/compiler/generator/llvm/llvm_dynamic_dsp_aux.cpp#L306-L323),
[Clang](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/compiler/generator/llvm/clang_code_container.cpp#L115-L145)).
Impulse comparisons default to tolerance rather than bit identity
([filesCompare](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/tests/impulse-tests/tools/filesCompare.cpp#L34-L193)).

Faust's optional work-stealing scheduler conflicts with V2's qualified single render thread
([scheduler](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/compiler/generator/wss_code_container.cpp#L135-L230)).
Generic clone/preset helpers do not establish complete running-DSP state, and SoundUI allocates whole
file-length buffers
([clone caveat](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/compiler/generator/cpp/cpp_code_container.cpp#L662-L684),
[SoundUI](https://github.com/grame-cncm/faust/blob/ee0013becc4ed9717517c45ce821e0f0459f1350/architecture/faust/gui/SoundUI.h#L67-L161)).

## Decision

- **Investigate on demand:** a restricted, pinned Faust-to-audited-native-effect authoring path.
  Faust remains an offline build tool; exact reviewed generated bytes are adapted to V2's existing
  descriptor, state, bank, package and preparation contracts.
- **Preserve:** V2 numeric laws, homogeneous lane banking, per-effect state/provenance, source rings,
  content identity and single-thread render model.
- **Reject:** libfaust/JIT in product render, the generic Faust ABI as V2's plugin ABI, default
  fast-math, work stealing, SoundUI asset loading, and clone/UI presets as continuation snapshots.

## Gates for a future generated-effect path

1. Freeze the Faust subset, commit, options, architecture template and generated-source digest.
2. No JIT/libfaust dependency reaches render; fast math, contraction, scheduler generation and
   unspecified approximations are disabled.
3. Exact scalar/Simd4/Simd8/Wasm corpora cover signed zero, NaN policy, denormals and non-vacuity.
4. Map stable parameter IDs, units, domains, smoothing, ports, link modes, latency, tail, reset and
   complete running state into the V2 effect contract.
5. Soundfile primitives are rejected or lowered to prepared V2 source handles; realtime audits and
   duration-independent resource caps remain green.
6. Benchmarks use one frozen workload and V2's one-warmup/two-round protocol, never best-of option
   searching. CID continues to identify exact bytes, not trust or semantic parity.

## Cross-check found in V2

Current lane source states that `Lane::fma` is deliberately unfused everywhere
([lane contract](https://github.com/misofm/engine-v2/blob/90c3b9a598f1244938d9cdcce04c4a4641c6b758/crates/miso-engine-lane/src/lib.rs#L19-L23)),
while `REALTIME_DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md` still describes hardware/soft fused identity
([stale policy](https://github.com/misofm/engine-v2/blob/90c3b9a598f1244938d9cdcce04c4a4641c6b758/docs/REALTIME_DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md#L151-L154)).
Executable source/gates are authoritative, but the final synthesis must schedule a bounded
documentation correction before making further public determinism claims.

## Limitation

Faust's many target architectures are strengths for its ecosystem, not evidence that their default
outputs meet V2's exact cross-target arithmetic contract. A generated-effect path is worthwhile only
for a real effect-authoring need.

## Closure

Closed as completed research and superseded by final synthesis #268. Faust integration remains
demand-gated; only the independent FMA documentation correction is immediate.
